The node heartbeat is written straight into the source: §1mNextRegistrationTick = aTick + (registered ? 600 : 20)§r.

Translated: after a successful registration, an idempotent recheck every §1600 ticks (30 s)§r confirms the binding holds; on failure, a retry every §120 ticks§r — it never gives up.

The registration itself carries §3cross-dimensional chunk loading§r, so remote nodes take effect at once.

§cBreaking a node refunds no singularity — the consumption marker stays, no freeloading.§r
